Quentin Tarantino is officially a dad of three children.

The Oscar-winning director, 63, and his wife, Daniella Pick Tarantino, 43, have welcomed their third baby, People exclusively confirmed on Sunday.

A representative for Tarantino told the publication that the “Pulp Fiction” filmmaker and the singer were “overjoyed to announce the birth of their third child, a baby boy.”

The Tarantinos previously welcomed son Leo in February 2020 and daughter Adriana in July 2022. They have not yet revealed the name of their newborn.

Representatives for Tarantino didn’t immediately respond to HuffPost’s request for comment.

Tarantino and Pick, the daughter of Israeli pop star Svika Pick, first met in Israel in 2009 while he was promoting his Oscar-winning film “Inglourious Basterds.” They got engaged in summer 2017 and tied the knot in a Los Angeles ceremony in November 2018.

Tarantino has appeared to do a 180 on his stance on love after telling GQ in 2009 that his career would always take precedence over his romantic life.

“When I’m doing a movie, I’m not doing anything else. It’s all about the movie. I don’t have a wife. I don’t have a kid. Nothing can get in my way. The whole fucking world can go to hell and burst into flames. I don’t care. This is my life. It’s Mount Everest,” Tarantino said at the time.

He explained, “I’m not saying that I’ll never get married or have a kid before I’m 60. But I’ve made a choice, so far, to go on this road alone. Because this is my time. This is my time to make movies.”
